2027-05-02.title: Fifth Sunday after Qyomtho
readings: The Spirit of truth will guide you
Rejoice before the Lord at the feast of weeks
David becomes great, for the Lord was with him
Filled with joy and the Holy Spirit
Seek the things that are above
Your pain will turn into joy
2027-05-02.verse: So you have pain now; but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.

2027-05-06.title: Suloko · The Ascension of our Lord
readings: The tablets placed in the ark
Elijah taken up; Elisha takes his mantle
I will write my law on their hearts
He was lifted up, and a cloud took him
He blessed them and was carried up into heaven
2027-05-06.verse: While he was blessing them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

2027-05-09.title: Sixth Sunday after Qyomtho
readings: I am the Lord; I will free you
Your immortal spirit is in all things
I have swept away your sins like a cloud
The eyes of your heart enlightened
It is to your advantage that I go away
2027-05-09.verse: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

2027-05-16.title: The Sunday of Pentecost
readings: The Advocate will teach you everything
The spirit rests on the seventy elders
The land divided among the tribes
The spirit of God comes upon Saul
A new heart and a new spirit
Varieties of gifts, the same Spirit
Another Advocate, to be with you for ever
2027-05-16.verse: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them ability.

2027-05-23.title: First Sunday after Pentecost
readings: The manna ceases; they eat the produce of the land
Filled with the spirit of the Lord
Plans for your welfare, a future with hope
The Bereans examine the Scriptures daily
2027-05-23.verse: By contrast, the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, generosity, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.

2027-05-30.title: Second Sunday after Pentecost
readings: You shall be holy, for I am holy
David becomes king over all Israel
The exiles weep, fast and pray
The living God, whose kingdom shall never be destroyed
I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh
No condemnation for those in Christ Jesus
Whoever loses his life for my sake will find it
2027-05-30.verse: Whoever does not take up the cross and follow me is not worthy of me. Those who find their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for my sake will find it.
